name: ADHD
description: Pattern related to attention regulation, task initiation, and executive function.
safetyGuidance: This is not a clinical diagnosis. Informational pattern match based on executive function and focus reports.

solutions.title: AI Task Breaker
solutions.purpose: Help the user break an overwhelming task into smaller actionable steps.

solutions.title: Focus Session
solutions.purpose: Give the user a structured period of focused work.
instructions: Pick exactly ONE task to focus on during this window.
Start the timer and work continuously until completion.
Take a complete rest when the timer rings.

solutions.title: Task Prioritization
solutions.purpose: Help the user organize tasks into High, Medium, and Low priority.

solutions.title: Short Movement / Reset
solutions.purpose: Give the user a short physical reset between periods of attention.
instructions: Stand up from your desk or seat immediately.
Reach up high toward the ceiling and hold for 15 seconds.
Take a quick walk around your room or drink a glass of water.

solutions.title: Mindfulness Meditation
instructions: Sit comfortably with your spine upright.
Focus your attention entirely on the physical sensation of breathing.
When your attention wanders, notice it calmly without frustration.
Gently redirect your focus back to your next breath.
